label: British outposts
summary: Three military settlements on the north coast, all abandoned.

label: South Australian frontier
summary: Annexation, Palmerston, the Overland Telegraph, pastoral runs and punitive expeditions.

label: Chief Protector
summary: Commonwealth rule; the Chief Protector is legal guardian of Aboriginal children and controls Aboriginal women for life.

label: Assimilation and wardship
summary: The Welfare Ordinance makes 15,711 Aboriginal Territorians wards of the state.

label: Land rights
summary: Policy shifts to self-management; the Land Rights Act passes in 1976.

label: Self-government
summary: The NT Government takes over most services; the Royal Commission into Aboriginal Deaths in Custody reports in 1991.

label: The Intervention
summary: The Commonwealth suspends the Racial Discrimination Act to impose income management, alcohol bans, compulsory leases and extra police.

label: Stronger Futures to Royal Commission
summary: Intervention measures continue; Don Dale footage leads to the 2017 Royal Commission.

label: Current settings
summary: Age of criminal responsibility back to 10, bail and youth justice tightened, Child Placement Principle weakened, record imprisonment.
